verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of version-control integration, diffable/text-based scene formats, merge tools, or built-in multi-user collaboration features (e.g., Perforce/Git integration, Multi-User Editing) — topics that would be expected for a studio-lead evaluating editor-tooling for team workflows. Existing docs cover Blueprints, C++, Python scripting, plugins, cooking, and remote control APIs, none of which address mergeability or VCS compatibility.
